rows.say: Who was Hannibal's idol?
rows.text: Hannibal Barca was generally considered his own idol because of his incredible military genius, particularly his daring strategy at the Battle of Cannae. Unlike many generals of his time who fought for a ruler, he was famous for commanding the Carthaginian army against Rome without direct orders from Carthage itself during the Second Punic War. Some also credit the Greek philosopher Pythagoras with influencing Hannibal through his love of music and mathematics, but Pythagoras himself wasn't exactly an idol in the modern sense of being looked up to as a perfect role model for Hannibal's actions.
